description:
Portable Windows 11 toolkit for performance tweaks, maintenance, automation, and system utilities.

TweakHub is a Windows 11 toolkit for applying reversible registry and power tweaks, running maintenance scripts, managing custom tools and profiles, launching system utilities, and installing curated software through WinGet or trusted project pages.
What's new in 1.4.2
TweakHub 1.4.2 expands the app beyond gaming with a curated professional toolkit for developers, technicians, system administrators, recovery work, and security research.
Professional tools
- Development & DevOps: Arduino IDE, Docker Desktop, and Podman Desktop.
- Firmware, storage, and networking: UEFITool, Rufus, Ventoy, Nmap, and WinSCP.
- Recovery & forensics: Windows File Recovery, TestDisk & PhotoRec, and Autopsy.
- OSINT & security: ExifTool, SpiderFoot, Sherlock, and OWASP Amass.
- Performance analysis: Windows Performance Toolkit now clearly identifies WPR, WPA, and Xperf and links to the official Windows ADK installer.
Faster access to advanced Windows consoles
Quick Access now includes Computer Management, Performance Monitor, Reliability Monitor, Windows Defender Firewall with Advanced Security, Local Security Policy, Local Users and Groups, certificates for the current user and local computer, and Indexing Options.
One-click repair and setup workflows
New automated workflows repair WinGet, Microsoft Store, Xbox Gaming Services, Print Spooler, and OneDrive, plus a guided WSL 2 + Ubuntu setup. A repair is marked successful only after its specific postcondition is checked; the Xbox workflow also validates the Microsoft Authenticode signature of the downloaded repair tool before execution.
All new interface text is localized in English, Italian, Spanish, Russian, Japanese, and Simplified Chinese.
Full Changelog: v1.4.1...v1.4.2
